items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: they called Tootie, send him out here, and I crept across the stage there, and got up there and Ory was so weak... because I know just what he wants to do

ctx.x: Seems like somebody in the audience ask, 'where's my Marduti Tootie,' and the man said, Oh, that is right. And they called Tootie, send him out here, and I crept across the stage there, and got up there and Ory was so weak, you understand, and he was so glad when I come, you know, because I know just what he wants to do, you know?
